verdict.rationale: An audit trail is a fair question for double-entry accounting software, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents an audit log or change history showing who changed what and when. Accountant access to journal entries, team-member seats and journal-entry/report APIs are related features, not an audit trail, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can see a complete audit trail of who changed what and when across the entire ledger
